brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four bases (piece:0..3,0,0), each holding a third-depth drain bin with soil and a plant (prop:1–4).

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 is set to irrigation. It enters cell (0,0) at its west face (edge 3) and passes straight through cells (1,0), (2,0) and (3,0).
The pipe passes under all four bins. The configurator only checks fit, so it does not show that water actually reaches each bin, and the pipe does not have a separate outlet into each one.
The configurator does not check whether parts hold water or how the material copes with it. That depends on the material and print settings you choose.

finish.summary: I built a four-cell planter. Four full bases sit in a straight row from (0,0) to (3,0). One water pipe run, set to irrigation, goes into the west face of cell (0,0) and passes straight through all four bases. A pipe running through a cell leaves room only for a shallow (third-depth) bin, so each cell has a third-depth drain bin, filled with soil and planted. The open side faces are capped, except the face where the pipe comes in, which is left open. The joints between the bases are bolted. check_build found no rule issues and no collisions between parts, and from above all four plants can be seen. There are 29 parts, and the print estimate is about 1813 g of filament and about 2678 minutes.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
